notes: Guns, first person and last-man-standing rounds put this in Shooter, and free-for-all elimination is the Arena Deathmatch row rather than Battle Royale, whose ground loot the author explicitly refused and whose shrinking boundary is never mentioned. Shape is space-staged because players spawn in a lobby and are sent to the battlefield a minute later, which is a match area fully separated from where people wait — that is the P4; the preset's lane-network was substituted for it and powerup-buffs dropped as contradicted by 'only bought guns', keeping cover-elevated (tiered, nothing overhangs on a small base) and path-loop. The gun purchase lands on station-loadout as the rack where players swap weapons. Decided without a user: the eight-player cap and the small modern military base come from the answers, the run ends when one player is left so no separate objective geometry is placed, and the admin balloon grants and owner chat title are permissions and UI with nothing for the layout to express.
